extraction._comment: Feature extraction uses the cicflowmeter PyPI package in-process (backend/extraction/extract.py). Run scripts/patch_cicflowmeter.py once after installing requirements, see README.md.

verdict_gate._comment: Confidence gate for the headline traffic verdict (backend/prediction/predict.py::summarize_states). An attack class reads red ATTACK only when its OWN share of scored flows reaches min_ratio for its tier (or the deterministic signature layer confirmed it); otherwise amber SUSPICIOUS. Purely percentage-based, no absolute flow count. Edit and restart the backend to retune.

response._comment: Exact IPs protected from response blocks. Add gateway, DNS/DHCP, management and operator addresses here.

xdr._comment: Demo-depth XDR panels and routes. All capabilities default off so the existing NIDS pipeline and response shapes remain unchanged. Enable only the capabilities needed for a local demo; llm.endpoint is the sole optional outbound destination.
